up: Show the exact activity values (including the standard_type, relation, value, and units) and the canonical SMILES for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4649973.
sql: SELECT a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities a JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE a.assay_id = (SELECT assay_id FROM assays WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649973') AND a.standard_relation = '='
